value.rationale: The exact worst-case relocation distance from every optimal domination configuration is a motivated unknown invariant in shortest reconfiguration of dominating sets. The sharp n/2 budget, explicit farthest-state construction, and compact two-defect encoding yield exact optimal planning, rather than a routine recounting of known minimum-set counts. No arbitrary parameter slice was chosen: the residue n congruent 1 modulo 3 is the first nonrigid two-unit slack class and has a naturally complete classification.
